name: Monster Shop Simulator
detailed_description:
In a magical and cozy anime world filled with mysterious eggs that rain down from the sky,

manage the only monster shop in town in this single-player simulation game!

Gacha Eggs & Cosmic Surprises

Not all eggs are born equal… Open them like a gacha lootbox: some contain adorable

creatures, others? Total garbage. Too scared to open one? Sell it as-is—you might make a

fortune... or lose a legend! Eggs drop from cosmic meteors at random times. Be quick to

collect them before NPCs grab them—or sneakily steal from them!

Tame or Lose!

Some creatures don’t want to be caught! Every egg has a hidden level. If your Taming Level

isn’t high enough, the monster might escape! Tame it and you can sell it for big bucks. Fail

and... oops, there it goes!

Monster Care

Take care of the monsters in your garden, train them, and sell them for a higher price.

Provide them with proper care, shelter, and attention to increase their value. Create the

perfect environment for your little monsters to thrive!

Haggling Like a Pro

Dealers meet best trader: Buyers and shady collectors will visit your shop daily. Haggle,

bluff, and outsmart them. Choose who to trust, who to scam, and when to open that one

mysterious egg you've been hiding…

Explore the Town & The Sky

Walk around the anime-inspired town: Chat with quirky NPCs, grab snacks, or overhear

rumors about rare eggs. Break fallen cosmic stones to find trapped monsters—whoever

breaks it, keeps it! Hire egg-hunters to collect eggs for you... or guard your shop from

thieves!

Customize Your Dream Shop

Decorate, expand, and level up your cozy little store: Change the floors, walls, and furniture

Expand your garden to raise more monsters Turn your shop into a monster café, a fancy

collector’s boutique—or a total mess. It’s up to you!

World Events & Cosmic Lore

The world is changing… Each season brings new eggs, new creatures, and new shop

visitors. A planet has exploded far away, sending unknown lifeforms crashing into your cozy

corner of the world. Are you just a shopkeeper—or something more?

Wishlist now and get ready to hatch chaos!

short_description: Manage the only monster shop in a cozy anime world where mysterious eggs fall from the sky! Hatch, tame, train, and trade adorable (or chaotic) creatures in this magical single-player simulation.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i3 2100 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 780 GTX or AMD Radeon R7 260X series
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i5-2500 3.30 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 970/Radeon RX470 or better
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
